name: What is the process for getting a wood fence repair estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a wood fence repair estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for a wood fence repair estimate typically begins with you contacting us to describe the issue. We then schedule a site visit to your property in Berkeley, Oakland, or the surrounding East Bay areas. During this visit, our team will thoroughly inspect your fence, assess the damage, and discuss your specific needs and preferences. Following the inspection, we will provide you with a detailed, no-obligation estimate outlining the proposed repairs and associated costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: To get a wood fence repair estimate, contact us to describe the issue, then we'll schedule a site visit for an inspection and a detailed, no-obligation estimate.
